name: BTC daytime reversal, nighttime cash (08 UTC)
author: Session strategy study authors

indicators.session split: D(h)=[8:00,20:00) UTC; N is complementary 12-hour block
indicators.signal: sign of previous return for same session

exit: Recompute each session; position is 0, +1 or -1 for session return
filters: Session return sign only; zero return maps to flat
claimed_performance: Paper compares 25 combinations and reports full-sample selections; costs exclude spread, slippage, venue fees, funding and taxes.
implementation_notes: Selected h is reported in paper; session-boundary search and full-sample selection create data-mining risk. Do not treat full-sample winner as validated.
